content:
Webb County has closed on the Casa Blanca Event Center property along U.S. 59 for $4.25 million, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The purchase covers two tracts totaling nearly 15 acres, including an approximately 30,000-square-foot event facility, the Times reported. Precinct 3 Commissioner John Galo stated the $4.25 million price, which the article says matched the seller's previously sought asking price; the seller is not named in the article. Two appraisals commissioned while the county considered the purchase placed the combined value of the two tracts at about $2.9 million, according to the Times.

Precinct 1 Commissioner Jesse Gonzalez said the county closed this past week and the property is now a Webb County building, the Times reported. Negotiations had continued for months, and an ALTA survey was completed ahead of closing after outside counsel requested it. No vote count is stated in the article.

The immediate purpose is a venue for county events while the pavilion at the Webb County Fairgrounds is under renovation or construction, including as a temporary venue for the upcoming second Mercado Festival, according to the Times.

What the purchase does not do, at least yet, is move the Tax Assessor-Collector's Office. No department moves have been approved, the Times reported. Tax Assessor-Collector Patricia Barrera told Commissioners Court on Oct. 13 that she did not believe the property would be ideal for her office, citing traffic along the state highway, safety concerns for elderly residents and people with disabilities visiting for vehicle registrations, license plates and placards, and a price above appraised value. Gonzalez described a possible future one-stop shop for different county departments and services, but that remains under consideration, according to the article.

The gap between the $4.25 million price and the roughly $2.9 million appraised value, and the still-undecided question of which departments — if any — will ultimately use the building, are the two points county residents will most reasonably watch next.

Sources:

  • Laredo Morning Times, "Webb County completes $4.25M purchase of Casa Blanca property," by David Gomez Jr., Oct. 27, 2026
  • KGNS, "Webb County Tax Assessor opposes possible move to Casa Blanca Ballroom," Oct. 22, 2026

Webb Watch 956
excerpt: Webb County closed this past week on the Casa Blanca Event Center along U.S. 59 for $4.25 million — above the roughly $2.9 million appraised value — for county events while the fairgrounds pavilion is under construction, but no department move, including the tax office, has been approved.
title: Webb County closes $4.25 million Casa Blanca purchase — above appraised value, tax-office move not approved
